prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1182; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows scraping and a dented rear quarter panel on the passenger side, with paint transfer and a cracked side mirror housing, all consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change. The damage pattern lines up with the impact as described, and no prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records. The proposed repair plan covers panel replacement, refinishing, and mirror assembly, and the labor hours submitted fit the work required. Two similar charges submitted on the same day are being reviewed before the estimate is finalized.
